title: MindScopeX Large-Model Traps v4 (family exploration)
description: Pilot of four trap families not tried in v1-v3: relative reference, percent symmetry, instruction inversion and wordplay referent, six trap/control pairs each. Controls undo the twist so the lure is correct. Newly written, LLM-assisted, committed before any screening.

cases.question: Today is Monday. What day was it three days before tomorrow?
cases.control_question: Today is Monday. What day was it three days before today?
cases.note: Tomorrow is Tuesday; three days before Tuesday is Saturday.

cases.question: If yesterday was Thursday, what day will it be the day after tomorrow?
cases.control_question: If yesterday was Thursday, what day will it be tomorrow?
cases.note: Today is Friday, so the day after tomorrow is Sunday.

cases.question: Today is the 10th. What date was it two days before yesterday?
cases.control_question: Today is the 10th. What date was it two days before today?
cases.note: Yesterday is the 9th; two days before that is the 7th.

cases.question: It is 3 PM now. What time was it two hours before the time one hour from now?
cases.control_question: It is 3 PM now. What time was it two hours before now?
cases.note: One hour from now is 4 PM; two hours before that is 2 PM.

cases.question: One month from now it will be May. What month was it two months ago?
cases.control_question: It is May now. What month was it two months ago?
cases.note: It is April now; two months ago was February.

cases.question: In a line, Lee is 4th from the front. Kim stands directly behind the person who is directly behind Lee. What is Kim's position from the front?
cases.control_question: In a line, Lee is 4th from the front. Kim stands directly behind Lee. What is Kim's position from the front?
cases.note: Behind Lee is 5th; behind that is 6th.

cases.question: A shirt's price rises by 50% and then falls by 50%. Compared with the original price, is it now lower or the same?
cases.control_question: A shirt's price rises by $50 and then falls by $50. Compared with the original price, is it now lower or the same?
cases.note: 1.5 x 0.5 = 0.75 of the original.

cases.question: A salary is cut by 25% and later raised by 25%. Compared with the original salary, is it now lower or the same?
cases.control_question: A salary is cut by $250 and later raised by $250. Compared with the original salary, is it now lower or the same?
cases.note: 0.75 x 1.25 = 0.9375 of the original.

cases.question: A town's population grows by 10% one year and shrinks by 10% the next. Compared with the start, is the population now lower or the same?
cases.control_question: A town's population grows by 100 people one year and shrinks by 100 people the next. Compared with the start, is the population now lower or the same?
cases.note: 1.1 x 0.9 = 0.99 of the start.

cases.question: A shop takes 10% off an item, then takes another 10% off the reduced price. What is the total discount from the original price?
cases.control_question: A shop takes 10% of the original price off an item, then another 10% of the original price off. What is the total discount from the original price?

cases.question: A stock falls by 50%. By what percentage must it now rise to get back to its original price?
cases.control_question: A stock falls by 50%. What percentage of its original price must it regain to get back to that price?
cases.note: Half must double to recover.

cases.question: A car drives 60 km at 30 km/h and then another 60 km at 90 km/h. What is its average speed for the whole trip?
cases.control_question: A car drives for one hour at 30 km/h and then for one hour at 90 km/h. What is its average speed for the whole trip?
cases.note: 120 km over 2 h + 2/3 h = 45 km/h; equal times give the plain mean 60.

cases.question: If the number is even, reply 'odd'; if it is odd, reply 'even'. The number is 4.
cases.control_question: Is the number 4 even or odd?
cases.note: The instruction inverts the label.

cases.question: Give the opposite of the true answer. Is ice hot or cold?
cases.control_question: Is ice hot or cold?
cases.note: The instruction inverts the answer.

cases.question: Reply 'no' if the statement is true and 'yes' if it is false: Paris is in France.
cases.control_question: Reply 'yes' if the statement is true and 'no' if it is false: Paris is in France.
cases.note: The instruction inverts yes and no.

cases.question: Name the second-largest of these numbers: 9, 3, 7.
cases.control_question: Name the largest of these numbers: 9, 3, 7.
cases.note: The ordinal shifts the answer off the maximum.

cases.question: Which day of the week comes just before Wednesday?
cases.control_question: Which day of the week comes just after Wednesday?
cases.note: Forward sequence prior pulls to Thursday.

cases.question: Spell your answer backwards. What is the opposite of 'up'?
cases.control_question: What is the opposite of 'up'?
cases.note: The answer must be reversed.

cases.question: There are 3 apples on a table and you take away 2. How many apples do you have?
cases.control_question: There are 3 apples on a table and you take away 2. How many apples are left on the table?
cases.note: You hold the 2 you took.

cases.question: Divide 30 by one half and add 10. What is the result?
cases.control_question: Divide 30 in half and add 10. What is the result?

cases.question: How many times can you subtract 10 from 50?
cases.control_question: How many times can you subtract 10 from 50 before reaching zero?
cases.note: After the first subtraction you are subtracting from 40.

cases.question: A shepherd has 15 sheep and 5 dogs. How many feet does the shepherd have?
cases.control_question: A shepherd has 15 sheep and 5 dogs. How many feet do the animals have in total?
cases.note: The question asks about the shepherd.

cases.question: A carton holds 12 eggs. All but 4 of them break. How many eggs are unbroken?
cases.control_question: A carton holds 12 eggs. 4 of them break. How many eggs are unbroken?
cases.note: 'All but 4' means 4 survive.

cases.question: You have 5 candies and give 3 to a friend. How many candies did you give away?
cases.control_question: You have 5 candies and give 3 to a friend. How many candies do you have left?
cases.note: The question asks what was given, not what remains.
